title: For networks that are marked as default external networks, show the network
question: For networks that are marked as default external networks, show the network ID, whether it is default, the tenant ID, network name, status, admin state up flag, MTU, standard attribute ID, and the minimum MTU within each tenant (partitioned and ordered by tenant ID), but exclude shared networks (i.e., networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'). Do not return any rounded answers.

SELECT 
    n.id AS network_id,
    e.is_default,
    n.tenant_id,
    n.name AS network_name,
    n.status,
    n.admin_state_up,
    n.mtu,
    n.standard_attr_id,
    MIN(n.mtu) OVER (PARTITION BY n.tenant_id ORDER BY n.tenant_id) AS min_mtu_per_tenant
FROM networks n
JOIN externalnetworks e ON n.id = e.network_id
WHERE e.is_default = 1
  AND n.id NOT IN (
    SELECT object_id 
    FROM networkrbacs 
    WHERE action = 'access_as_shared' 
      AND target_tenant IN ('*', '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
  )
